script_text: Aquarius, your Uranus-ruled Air energy hits a career crossroads this week. Wednesday's Mercury direct phase in your 11th House trines Jupiter in your 7th House, turning networking into real love or partnership opportunity. Saturn in your 3rd House asks you to sharpen your pitch. Thursday and Friday, Venus in Scorpio through your 10th House sweetens public reputation and brings a private career offer. Saturday and Sunday, the Sun enters Sagittarius in your 11th House and expands your wider social circle. Wednesday is your power day because Mercury activates your 11th House for career visibility. Tuesday is the hardest because the Sun squares Pluto, triggering workplace power struggles. Use your Air logic to renegotiate one contract, not to quit. Follow for daily updates.
